svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A channel: web 114 wide x 124 tall, two flanges standing 65 out

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (outside sizes). Blank 114 wide; the bending shop sets its length.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a 90 degree V in each end of the blank (these become the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: flanges): 109 mm wide at the end, point 54.5 mm in from the end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Web: four band slots 3 x 15 at 52 mm each side of centre, centred

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 40 mm above and below the middle; chain drill 3 mm, file square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Web: three 5.5 mm holes on a 45 mm circle round the middle, one

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: straight up, for the tube flange.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bend both flanges 90 degrees the same way, inside radius about 3.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr and round the V edges so they cannot score the pole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the pole bears on the four V edges; each band runs round

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the pole, through two slots and across the outside of the web.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: on a 114 mm tube all four V edges touch and it does not rock.
